title: Comparison of Femtosecond Laser-Assisted and Ultrasound-Assisted Cataract Surgery with Focus on Endothelial Analysis

indication: Senile cataract with clear cornea, age 50 years or more (LOCS III: FLACS grade 2 in 29, grade 3 in 33, grade 4 in 3; conventional grade 2 in 50, grade 3 in 15); glaucoma, ocular hypertension, pseudoexfoliation, corneal disease and previous corneal or lens surgery excluded

groups.description: Low-energy femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery (Ziemer FEMTO LDV Z8: lens fragmentation and 5 mm capsulotomy) followed by phacoemulsification and NS-60YG IOL; randomized, single-centre, same surgeon; 63 completed
Conventional ultrasound cataract surgery (CataRhex 3 easyPhaco, 2.2 mm main incision, manual capsulorhexis, stop and chop) with NS-60YG IOL; 63 completed

series.baseline_label: Pre-operative (Table 2, 'All grades' block) = preoperative central ECD of the operated eye
series.notes: Table 2 'Femtosecond Laser Group' column, 'All grades' rows Pre-operative, 4 weeks postop and 12 weeks postop (mean ± SD); 4 weeks = 28/30.4375 and 12 weeks = 84/30.4375 months. Tomey EM-3000 specular microscopy (best of 15 images). Per-visit n not tabulated.

series.baseline_label: Pre-operative (Table 2, 'All grades' block) = preoperative central ECD of the operated eye
series.notes: Table 2 'Conventional Group' column, 'All grades' rows Pre-operative, 4 weeks postop and 12 weeks postop (mean ± SD); 4 weeks = 28/30.4375 and 12 weeks = 84/30.4375 months. Per-visit n not tabulated.

exclusions.reason: Subsets of the same eyes as the all-grades series (grade-4 eyes appear only in 'All grades'); the analysed subgroup n are not reported

exclusions.what: Table 2 age and ACD rows; p-value column; Tables 3-5
exclusions.reason: Not endothelial cell density; p-values are not admissible

notes: Role: two established cataract techniques randomized against each other without an investigational agent (femtosecond-assisted surgery is listed under the protocol's cataract context); both control-role, separate groups.
The second follow-up is labelled '12 weeks postop' in Table 2 and the Results text, whereas Methods 2.2 states specular measurements at 4 and 8 weeks; the table label is used.
Of 65 randomized eyes per arm, 2 per arm missed postoperative examinations and were excluded (126 of 130 completed); n = 63 per arm, but the n behind each Table 2 value is not stated.
